title: Release quest-cli 0.3.3
description: User-approved (2026-09-05, AskUserQuestion) to unblock opum-agent and opum-doc's 'agents --check --require-installed' CI, which stays broken until a release carries QCLI-227's --target flag. Follows docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md and the QCLI-166/QCLI-224 precedent exactly.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Root package.json, QUEST_VERSION, QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION, optionalDependencies, and the conformance fixture bumped to 0.3.3 and committed together with freshly-built (Bun 1.3.14) platform packages so check:packages passes on first CI attempt
v0.3.3 tag pushed and prepublication-qualification.yml dispatched against it; native-execution receipt downloaded and bun run receipt:require passes

release.yml dispatched with publish=false (dry run) then publish=true against v0.3.3, gated on the receipt - publish=true is the one step requiring the repo's own user's direct, immediate go-ahead, not an earlier general approval
Post-publish clean-install smoke (version, manifest, task op, and the new --target claude flag) passes against the published registry artifacts
bun run receipt:verify-published passes against the six published platform tarballs
docs/reference/quest-cli-release-truth.md gets a new dated section for 0.3.3

Release notes state this adds --target claude|codex to quest agents and quest init --agent-instructions (QCLI-227), fixing opum-agent/opum-doc's agents --check --require-installed once they update to it, with a same-release fix so the claude-target block's own CI hint names --target claude instead of the codex-target command (QCLI-231); the codex/AGENTS.md default is unchanged for existing callers

implementationNotes: AC1: bumped package.json (version, optionalDependencies), src/application/version.ts (QUEST_VERSION), src/contract/tracker/index.ts (QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION), fixtures/tracker/v1/conformance.json (questVersion) all to 0.3.3. Repo-wide grep confirmed no other hand-edited 0.3.2 references remained outside .quest/ task history and generated npm/quest-* manifests. Rebuilt all six platform binaries with the pinned Bun 1.3.14 (matches package.json's packageManager exactly - checked before touching anything) via bun run build:packages, which also regenerated questPlatformPackages' checksums. bun run check:packages and bun run test:packages both exit 0. Regenerated CLAUDE.md's managed block via the from-source CLI (agents --update-instructions --target claude) rather than hand-editing it - confirms it correctly now reads 'Quest CLI 0.3.3' and 'quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude' (QCLI-231's fix). Full bun run check green: 403/403 tests.

AC2: tagged v0.3.3 at a700775 (dev tip after the version-bump merge), pushed, dispatched prepublication-qualification.yml explicitly against the tag (run 33950259801, not the automatic push-triggered run) per the runbook's warning that the push trigger's paths filter may not fire on a tag. All six platform jobs passed (darwin/linux/win32 x arm64/x64), each attesting the committed binary is byte-identical to the blob at that ref rather than rebuilding. Downloaded native-execution-receipt.json and gated it: 'bun run receipt:require' reports 'Native-execution receipt binds 0.3.3 at a700775 across all six platforms', exit 0.

AC3: user gave explicit, immediate go-ahead via AskUserQuestion right before dispatch (not the earlier general 'cut 0.3.3 now' answer) - shown the exact irreversibility, the full qualification state, and the pre-publish recheck results. Dispatched publish=false first (run 33950589656, all green, expected 'Stored NPM_TOKEN does not authenticate' annotation since this repo uses OIDC trusted publishing, not the stored token). Then publish=true (run 33955399180): Publish and 'Verify the registry serves what was published' both green.

AC4: fresh isolated npm install of @opum-ai/quest@0.3.3 (no local checkout involved). quest --version -> 0.3.3. quest manifest --json -> 48 commands. quest init --agent-instructions --target claude wrote the managed block into CLAUDE.md with no AGENTS.md ever created; quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude exited 0; the block's own CI-hint prose correctly reads --target claude (QCLI-231's fix, confirmed live against the published bytes). task create/task list round-tripped normally.
AC5: bun run receipt:verify-published -- 0.3.3 reported 'Receipt matches every platform package published as 0.3.3', exit 0.

AC6: added a new dated 'Current publication state (2026-09-05)' plus a full '0.3.3 release' section to docs/reference/quest-cli-release-truth.md (SHA-256/npm shasum/integrity tables, qualification run links, receipt binding, post-publish smoke results), following the existing '0.2.9 corrective release' style. Noted, without backfilling, that this doc's 'Current publication state' was never updated across 0.3.0/0.3.1/0.3.2 - a pre-existing gap. lore check --strict and lore validate --strict both exit 0 after the edit.
finalSummary: Released @opum-ai/quest 0.3.3, carrying QCLI-227 (--target claude|codex on quest agents/quest init --agent-instructions) and QCLI-231 (the block's own CI hint correctly names --target claude). Followed docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md exactly: version bump across all hand-edited locations, local platform rebuild with the pinned Bun 1.3.14 before any commit, tag v0.3.3 dispatched for qualification explicitly (not relying on the automatic push trigger), native-execution receipt gated locally, pre-publish recheck (all 7 packages still at 0.3.2 registry-side, no name/repo drift), dry run then real publish, both green. Independently verified from outside the workflow: npm view shows 0.3.3 live; a from-scratch isolated install proved --target claude works end-to-end against the published bytes (block written into CLAUDE.md, zero AGENTS.md created, --require-installed --target claude exits 0, CI hint reads correctly); receipt:verify-published matched all six platform tarballs. Updated docs/reference/quest-cli-release-truth.md with full evidence, lore check/validate --strict clean. dev has not yet been promoted to main (12 commits behind at release time); the publish itself does not depend on that promotion since the tag and published bytes are commit-pinned, independent of any branch pointer - tracked as separate, ordinary follow-up delivery.
